title: Unit – 1 : Session – 3 : SLO – 2  |  Implementation of Structures in C — Match the Following
sections: I. Match the Following
1. struct keyword — O. Used to define a structure.
2. Dot operator (.) — K. var.member.
3. Structure variable declaration — T. After structure definition.
4. Member access — M. Access structure members.
5. Structure with array — A. Structure array.
6. Pointer to structure — R. struct *ptr;.
7. Arrow operator (->) — S. Member access via pointer.
8. Nested structure — N. Structure inside structure.
9. Structure parameter passing — L. Pass by value.
10. Structure with function — Q. Can return a structure.
11. typedef — D. Define custom type name.
12. Structure size — I. Sum of all members (aligned).
13. Enum with structure — H. Valid declaration.
14. Array inside structure — B. Allowed in structure.
15. Structure inside array — P. struct Student s[5];.
16. Self-referential structure — E. Points to same type.
17. Structure initialization — J. = { val1, val2 }.
18. Dynamic structure allocation — F. malloc(sizeof(struct)).
19. sizeof with structure — G. Gives memory size.
20. Structure copy — C. Allowed with = operator.
